verdict.rationale: Canny documents an official JavaScript SDK for identifying users and has a developer docs site (with llms.txt) that AI-native builders could reference, but there's no evidence of broader official SDKs (e.g., server-side/language-specific clients) or a discoverable OpenAPI spec (all probed endpoints 404), limiting build-against options mainly to the JS SDK and manual API calls. Missing for 10: multi-language/server SDK coverage, published OpenAPI/schema for programmatic client generation, independent evidence of real-world SDK usage.
